crossRefs.note: “Make the arrows sharp! Hold the shields firmly! Yahweh has stirred up the spirit of the kings of the Medes, because…
and all the kings of Zimri, all the kings of Elam, and all the kings of the Medes;
The sons of Japheth were: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.
The sons of Japheth: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.
in the third year of his reign, he made a feast for all his princes and his servants; the power of Persia and Media…
All the acts of his power and of his might, and the full account of the greatness of Mordecai, to which the king…
Behold, I will stir up the Medes against them, who will not value silver, and as for gold, they will not delight in it.
A grievous vision is declared to me. The treacherous man deals treacherously, and the destroyer destroys. Go up, Elam…
PERES: your kingdom is divided, and given to the Medes and Persians.”
Now, O king, establish the decree, and sign the writing, that it not be changed, according to the law of the Medes and…
Then I lifted up my eyes, and saw, and behold, there stood before the river a ram which had two horns. The two horns…
I saw the ram pushing westward, northward, and southward. No animals could stand before him. There wasn’t any who could…
The ram which you saw, that had the two horns, they are the kings of Media and Persia.
In the first year of Darius the son of Ahasuerus, of the offspring of the Medes, who was made king over the realm of…

people.name: Media
people.line: An ancient kingdom; part of the Persian Empire

translations.web: Prepare against her the nations, the kings of the Medes, its governors, and all its deputies, and all the land of their dominion!
translations.bsb: Prepare the nations for battle against her— the kings of the Medes, their governors and all their officials, and all the lands they rule.
translations.kjv: Prepare against her the nations with the kings of the Medes, the captains thereof, and all the rulers thereof, and all the land of his dominion.
translations.asv: Prepare against her the nations, the kings of the Medes, the governors thereof, and all the deputies thereof, and all the land of their dominion.
